tips.text: Run Isleweaver for the clamps instead of Steel Path Duviri; Steel Path pays only 5 more for a much longer run.
Use your own Amp in Isleweaver; it makes a bad random loadout survivable.
Bring Titania or Zephyr for the Orowyrm flight phase; flying ends it in seconds where the Sirocco takes a minute.
Expect about one evening: three to five runs, with the plants and Rune Marrow piling up on their own.
Buy Azothane for the mastery and the reach rather than as a main; most players pick Syam first.
Do the no-combat Duviri objectives first to bank decrees before the combat ones.
Stay out of the Orowyrm's mouth line, since its breath one-shots you, and shoot its orbs for a speed boost.
Do not abandon a Duviri Experience before the Orowyrm unless you only want plants or Maw Fang; you keep the pickups but lose the clamps.
Unlock Isleweaver with The Hex alone; you do not need its finale.
If you run Steel Path Duviri anyway, clear all three optional Undercroft portals for 24 clamps in about 20 minutes.
Skip the Kaithe in the Orowyrm's second phase; run to the arena sides and shoot the wyrmlings with your real primary.
Bring Electric damage for the Fragmented duet at the end of Isleweaver.
